newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: PDZ Holdings gets offer from Diperdana.
newsitem.headline: PDZ Holdings gets offer from Diperdana.

text.p: Malaysian shipper PDZ Holdings Bhd said on Friday that Diperdana Corp Bhd has made a bid to buy its entire company through an offer of three Diperdana shares for four PDZ stock.
In a statement sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, PDZ said its board would seek to appoint an independent adviser for the offer "as soon as possible."
Shares of PDZ and Diperdana, which is involved in shipping and haulage, were suspended on Friday. PDZ's stock closed at 13.70 ringgit on Thursday, while Diperdana finished at 20.80 ringgit.
PDZ asked the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange to continue suspending its stock trading until further notice.
Rumours of a deal between the two companies circulated in the stock market on Friday.
The offer from Diperdana covers 49.5 million PDZ shares. No ringgit value was placed on the offer.
Diperdana said in a letter to PDZ that the offer is conditional upon a number of issues including approvals for Diperdana's previously announced proposed bonus issue and proposed restructuring.

Diperdana announced an asset shuffling with Konsortium Perkapalan Bhd in July, under which Konsortium transferred to Diperdana all its shipping operations. Konsortium took on all the land-based transportation businesses.
